capabilities: Export annotations from supported video platforms into vault files
Sync annotations to a ReClipped account automatically or manually
Play annotated videos inside Obsidian and seek to annotated timestamps
Maintain internal links between annotations, channels, and platforms
Render snapshots as images and make annotation tags searchable
extras: The plugin requires a paid ReClipped subscription; without one it cannot be used. The README also includes developer setup instructions (NodeJS 16+, npm/yarn) for building from source.
problem: Annotations taken on videos with ReClipped stay in the ReClipped service and cannot be brought into or consumed inside an Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: our video-preview and timestamp-seek is inspired from it
the team of Readwise.io whose Official Readwise plugin inspired our work

summary: Official ReClipped plugin that exports video annotations from supported platforms into the vault, with in-Obsidian video playback and timestamp seeking.
